terms_of_use_prefix: Welcome to Naqaa! These Terms of Use ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Naqaa application ("App"), its services, and any content or features provided through the App. By accessing or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please refrain from using the App.
term_section_one_description: Naqaa is a water quality monitoring application connected to an IoT device that can be installed in any water source. The App reads data from the IoT device and presents it to the user. To access the App's features, users must log in via email or connect with their Google account.
term_section_two_subsection_one_descript: You may create a user account using your email or Google account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account information and are fully responsible for all activities that occur under your account.
term_section_two_subsection_two_descript: You agree to provide accurate and complete information during the registration process and to keep it up to date. Providing false information may result in the termination of your account.
term_section_three_subsection_one_descri: When using the App, you may be required to provide personal information such as your email, full name, and password. We treat your personal information with utmost care, and you consent to our collection, use, and storage of this information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
term_section_three_subsection_two_descri: The App is connected to an IoT device that monitors water quality. The data collected from this device, including water quality readings and other relevant information, will be stored in our databases, and may be used to improve the App's functionality and services.
term_section_three_subsection_three_desc: For detailed information about how we collect, use, and protect your data, please review our Privacy Policy.
term_section_four_subsection_one_descrip: The App may require access to certain features on your mobile device, including location, Wi-Fi, and device files. Granting these permissions is necessary for the App to function properly and provide the intended services.
term_section_five_subsection_one_descrip: You may use the App solely for its intended purpose of water quality monitoring and related activities.
term_section_five_subsection_two_descrip:
You shall not use the App for any illegal or unauthorized purpose. This includes but is not limited to:
- Uploading, transmitting, or sharing content that is harmful, offensive, or violating any applicable laws.

term_section_six_subsection_one_descript: The App and all its content, including but not limited to text, graphics, images, and logos, are the property of Naqaa or its licensors and are protected by intellectual property laws.
term_section_six_subsection_two_descript: Naqaa grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable license to access and use the App for its intended purpose.
term_section_seven_subsection_one_descri: You may terminate your use of the App at any time by uninstalling the App from your device.
term_section_seven_subsection_two_descri: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the App, at our discretion, if you violate these Terms or engage in any harmful activities that may adversely affect the App or its users.
term_section_eight_subsection_one_descri: The App is provided "as is" and without any warranty or guarantee of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy, reliability, or completeness of the data collected from the IoT device.

privacy_policy_prefix: Thank you for using the Naqaa application ("App"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our App. By using the App, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacy_section_one_subsection_one_descr: When you register an account on the App, we collect certain personal information, including your email, full name, and password. This information is necessary for creating and managing your account.
privacy_section_one_subsection_two_descr: The App is connected to an Internet of Things (IoT) device that monitors water quality. We collect data from this device, such as water quality readings and other relevant information, to provide you with the intended services.
privacy_section_one_subsection_three_des: When you use the App, we may collect certain information automatically, including your device's IP address, device type, operating system, and usage patterns. This information helps us improve the App's functionality and tailor our services to better suit your needs.
privacy_section_two_subsection_one_descr: We use the information collected to provide you with access to the App and its features, as well as to improve and enhance the App's functionality and user experience.
privacy_section_two_subsection_two_descr: We may use your email address to communicate with you regarding updates, service notifications, and other relevant information related to the App.
privacy_section_two_subsection_three_des: We may use the collected data, including IoT device data, for analysis and research purposes to better understand water quality trends and environmental patterns. However, this data will be anonymized and aggregated to protect your privacy.
privacy_section_three_subsection_one_des: We may share your personal information with third-party service providers who assist us in delivering the App's features and services. These providers are obligated to handle your information securely and only use it for the purposes specified by us.
privacy_section_three_subsection_two_des: We may disclose your personal information if required by law or in response to valid legal requests.
privacy_section_four_subsection_one_desc: We retain your account information as long as your account is active or as necessary to comply with legal obligations.
privacy_section_four_subsection_two_desc: We store IoT device data for a reasonable period to maintain historical records for analysis and research purposes.
privacy_section_five_subsection_one_desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy_section_five_subsection_two_desc: While we take measures to secure your data, you are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and not sharing them with others.
privacy_section_six_subsection_one_descr: The App may contain links to external websites or services not operated by us. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of such websites or services. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies separately.
privacy_section_seven_subsection_one_des: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on this page, and the "Last updated" date at the top will be revised accordingly.
